Select compounds with IC50 activities in nM against human RAC-alpha serine/threonine-protein kinase (CHEMBL4282). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, then docs via assays.doc_id, then compound_structures, then compound_records. Filter by target CHEMBL4282 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (coalesce DOI then PMID), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate.
